name: Ticonderoga class
note: US Navy Aegis guided-missile cruiser (CG-47), SPY-1A/B phased-array radar. Figures are for the VLS ships (CG-52 onward) with two 61-cell Mk-41 launchers = 122 cells firing SM-2/SM-6, SM-3, ESSM, Tomahawk and VL-ASROC, plus 8 Harpoon in separate launchers. Two SH-60 (LAMPS III) helicopters. The class is being progressively retired by ~2027. Crew and speed are not in the retrieved excerpt.

name: Type 055 (Renhai)
note: PLAN Type 055 (NATO/US: Renhai), a large stealth multi-mission combatant the US classifies as a cruiser; primary escort for Chinese carriers. Dual-band radar with four Type 346B AESA panels. 112 universal VLS cells (64 fwd + 48 aft) firing HHQ-9 SAM, YJ-18 anti-ship, CJ-10 land-attack and (tested) YJ-20/YJ-21 anti-ship ballistic missiles; hangar for two helicopters. Full-load displacement and crew are not in the retrieved excerpt.

name: Slava class
note: Soviet/Russian Project 1164 Atlant guided-missile cruiser. Long-range S-300F (SA-N-6) SAM system with 64 missiles in below-deck rotary launchers; the primary offensive load is 16 P-1000 Vulkan (SS-N-12) supersonic anti-ship missiles in fixed deck launchers, plus 40 SA-N-4 short-range SAMs. MR-800 Voskhod (Top Pair) long-range air-search radar; one Ka-27 helicopter. Three built; Moskva sank in 2022. Crew and speed are not in the retrieved excerpt.
